experience.name: Valueminer
description: A low-code application in a production company environment. Clients can build their own configuration around the system.
I worked on JSON configuration, Firebird conversion, and backend tooling around the product.

page.title: Experience at Valueminer
page.metaDescription: This page describes the time that developer Denis Mathan experienced at Valueminer.
intro: In simplified terms, Valueminer sells a web-based management program that can be customized to meet customer requirements using low-code. In theory, it is a highly dynamic tool, limited only by the lack of imagination of the users. In practice, these imaginative ideas still need to be developed before they can be configured. This was part of my responsibilities at Valueminer.
My tools there included AWS, Docker, Angular with Typescript, and Golang in the backend.

experience.name: Internship Coma
description: My first experience in the IT working world outside university projects.
A five-month internship that gave me my first real company context.

page.title: Internship at Coma
page.metaDescription: This page describes the time that developer Denis Mathan experienced at coma.
intro: All in all, it was a very nice time there, I had nice colleagues, a pleasant working atmosphere and I got very good work assignments right from the start. I'm very grateful to my boss at the time, especially for this last aspect. She not only challenged me, but also encouraged me. For example, in addition to my tasks, I had to give a presentation on any IT topic for the team meeting every month. Most of the time, I couldn't tell the team anything new, but I learned a lot in the process.

page.title: First App
page.metaDescription: The website describes the beginnings of a program to support musicians that Denis Mathan did in college.
intro: The project started in the fourth semester during the subject Software Engineering. The task was to develop a simple app. However, since I also like to have a practical benefit from projects and had this idea, I overshot the mark a bit.

I had given myself two weeks for this task. It couldn't be much more, because there were still some other tasks for the university on the agenda. Our professor had suggested Cordova for the implementation. With this technology I finally developed a quite decent program for my level at that time. Unfortunately, the usability was too bad for me to ever use it. But I learned a lot and discovered the topic for my bachelor thesis.
If you are interested in the details of the program, feel free to visit me on my Github. Be warned though, this was the first app I ever made and the code looks accordingly.

intro: Welcome to the presentation of my very rudimentary chess program. I have programmed it with Java. First basics are already developed, but it is still a long way to the finished game, which I will probably not go. But it has already fulfilled the purpose of teaching me object-oriented programming and Java. If you are interested in the already existing code, just visit me on Github.
